result.summary: The page is largely well-formed: the header, search bar, promo banner, carousels, and bottom navigation align cleanly with consistent spacing. The only clear defect is a misspelled search placeholder. Light gray secondary text is a possible minor contrast concern. Clipped carousel items and the cut-off card at the bottom were excluded as intended scroll/viewport behavior.

issues.description: The search bar placeholder reads 'Restarants, dishes, groceries', which misspells 'Restaurants'.
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder text to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.

issues.description: Secondary metadata text (delivery fees, rating count '(500+)', and the '25–35 min' line) is light gray on white, which may fall below recommended contrast ratios for small text.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary gray text to meet at least WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1) for small text.
